$comment: MACHINE half of the /anthropic/v1/messages contract; the HUMAN half is anthropic-messages.md. The gateway inspects only the fields and headers declared here — the Anthropic Messages body is the vendor's and streams through byte-unchanged. `upstream` declares, per rail, the URL and the credential header the gateway must produce; tests assert it on the fake upstream. `x-requirements` couples each path to its requirement; scripts/spec_gate.py resolves an ID against every page under specs/ (cross-cutting requirements have one heading).

authorization.description: the session token as a bearer — consulted first

x-api-key.description: the session token for SDKs that send x-api-key

anthropic-beta.description: comma-separated beta list; merged with oauth-2025-04-20 on the anthropic rail, dropped on the opencode rail

x-opencode-session.description: the Go rail's native session id — passthrough; supplied by the gateway when neither session header is present

x-claude-code-session-id.description: claude-code's session id — passthrough; the Go rail accepts it alone

body.description: an Anthropic Messages request; only `model` and `stream` are read

model.description: must name the session's model (family match on the anthropic rail) or one of the rail's policy `side_models` (claude-code's haiku side-calls); absent = filled with the wire id

stream.description: a streamed response is relayed as its SSE bytes, unchanged

upstream.$comment: per rail: what the fake upstream must receive. Credential placeholders name the Secret key, never a value.

opencode.session: x-opencode-session | X-Claude-Code-Session-Id passthrough; gateway session id when neither

output.description: the upstream response, status + headers (minus hop-by-hop) + body bytes, relayed unchanged; `retry-after` kept on 429

message.description: one line, never a credential value and never an upstream auth body

session-unknown.description: no session token, or a token no row's hash matches

session-released.description: the session was released by DELETE /sessions/{id}

credential-unresolved.description: the session's rail credential is a definitive miss (404/403/unlabeled/key absent)

credential-transient.description: the kube API failed or was unreachable while resolving the session's credential; retry

model-not-session.description: the body's model is not the session's model

dialect-unsupported-on-rail.description: the session's rail does not speak this path's dialect (the subscription token is Anthropic-only)

upstream-auth.description: the upstream answered 401/403 — the rail credential is bad; the upstream body is never relayed

upstream-unreachable.description: the upstream connection failed for a reason that is not a timeout (DNS, refused, TLS, reset); nothing reached the vendor

header-refused.description: a credential-shaped value in a header the gateway does not own — refused before any upstream call (the FU-251 tripwire)
